'''Animated rune armour''' is a player-created foe encountered at the [[Warriors' Guild]]. To summon one, players must use a [[rune full helm]], a [[rune platebody]] and [[rune platelegs]] on the [[magical animator]]. It is not recommended to farm animated rune for [[warrior token]]s due to its high defensive stats.

Low-levelled players are advised to bring food and wear stab-resistant armour, since this is the highest level animated armour. The player will get all of their [[rune armour]] parts back when it is defeated; however, any armour below [[Animated Black Armour|black]] will have a chance to lose pieces.

Like all other animated armour variants, it is immune to [[Ranged]] and [[Magic]] attacks. As a result of being immune to Ranged damage, the armour is effectively immune to [[burn]], which will be inflicted but reduced to 0 damage. It is also immune to [[poison]] and [[venom]].
